scope: Complete original hierarchy in all 60 source files used by this project, plus exact CAOP2025 parish clipping; not national Portuguese coverage.
method: Decode every declared hierarchy item; require all point chunks to match the original project provenance and decoded totals to match source headers. Preserve every class byte without remapping or filtering. Count entire source payloads separately from non-overlapping 1 km ownership footprints and exact parish points. Test original projected CAOP2025 vectors at boundary cells; interior cells accelerate checks without changing boundary membership. Polygon edges are included; source footprints use x>=xmin,x<xmax,y>ymin,y<=ymax. No ground, height, vegetation, NDVI, validity-of-terrain or display sampling filters. Counts are source point records, not physical feature counts or deduplicated laser shots.
